name: limit_create_material_without_a_source
why: A DENSITY NOBODY CAN TRACE IS A FALSE WEIGHT WAITING TO HAPPEN. The material has a name and a density but no source: it is refused, and the refusal says what a source is. The numbers of a material are the one thing in a part that is never measured again, so the place they came from is written with them.
defect_caught: Without the requirement a model fills the gap from memory (a density "about 1250" is how a part gets 1 per cent of false mass for good). The twin writes the same material with its source and succeeds.
